question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Miniture**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The incorrectly spelt word is: **Miniture** (Correct spelling: Miniature) (छोटा / सूक्ष्म)
 
• Meanings:
 
 
• **Merriment** (आनंद / हर्ष): Happiness and enjoyment, especially expressed through laughter and cheerful activity.
 
• **Yearn** (इच्छा / तृष्णा): To have an intense longing or desire for something, often accompanied by feelings of sadness or discontentment.
 
• **Zenith** (शीर्षक / चरम): The highest point or culmination of achievement or success; the peak or apex of something. 
 
 
 
• Explanation: The correct spelling for the word meaning "a very small representation or version of something, on a much smaller scale" is "**Miniature**." The misspelt word "**Miniture**" does not exist in English.
